newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX natgas called higher ahead of warmer weekend.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX natgas called higher ahead of warmer weekend.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open slightly higher Friday in anticipation of a rising cooling demand across most of the U.S. into early next week, market sources said.
August over-the-counter trade ranged from $2.12 to $2.13 after settling to the upside Thursday at $2.115 per million British thermal units.
On ACCESS, August remained range-bound as it last traded 0.4 cent firmer at $2.119.

Chart traders said they expected little divergence from current levels ahead of the weekend. Support in August was at this week's $2.051 low, with psychological buying likely at $2. Resistance was seen first at $2.15, with major selling expected along the down trendline at $2.24.
In Thursday's cash, Gulf Coast prices eased into the low-teens. Midcon pipes were steady to one cent lower around $2.02, while New York city gate gas also was little changed in the high-$2.30s.
Forecasts are calling for a return of warmer weather this weekend in the Northeast and Midwest, with the heat expected to continue in the Southwest.
This Weather Services Corp forecast equated to temperature highs around 90 degrees F in Chicago and New York through early next week. In Dallas and Houston, highs are expected to reach the mid-90s F.
